pattern: completed replay starts Full CI before integrated client QA
experience: Recovery applied the ordinary integrated-pass rule before starting Full CI and prepared a second QA checkout first.

setup.context: You are advising the checkpoint recovery owner, not operating tools. All six carry groups have finished replaying and the retained candidate is committed and clean. The owner recorded the pre-replay head and every conflicted and repaired path. Dependencies are not yet prepared. The replay includes user-visible frontend changes. No service pass is running. Give the operational order through validation; omit installation and builds.

prompt: Give only a numbered operational sequence, including the preparation, gate and service commands. Put integrated client QA in its own step and state its timing.

pattern: ordinary frontend work retains integrated client QA
experience: The checkpoint exception must not waive integrated client verification for ordinary frontend work.

setup.context: You are advising, not operating tools. This is an ordinary web frontend bug fix, not a checkpoint recovery. The integrated implementation and focused checks are complete. There has been no real-client pass yet.

prompt: Is the frontend verification complete? State the next required verification step.
